SELECT id, service_no AS serviceNo, order_id AS orderId, order_no AS orderNo, after_sale_type AS afterSaleType, status, apply_amount AS applyAmount, reason, user_remark AS userRemark, audit_remark AS auditRemark, receive_remark AS receiveRemark, return_express_name AS returnExpressName, return_express_no AS returnExpressNo, return_remark AS returnRemark, audit_time AS auditTime, return_time AS returnTime, receive_time AS receiveTime, refund_time AS refundTime, create_time AS createTime FROM shop_order_after_sale WHERE uid = #{uid} AND IFNULL(is_del, 0) = 0
AND status = #{dto.status}
AND ( service_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{dto.keyword}, '%') OR order_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{dto.keyword}, '%') )
ORDER BY create_time DESC, id DESC
